title: Count Digits
intro: Counting digits is O(log₁₀ n) work. Prefer math over string conversion in interviews unless leading zeros appear. Classic framing from the roadmap note “count digits in a number”.
intuition: Repeatedly divide by 10 (or use logs carefully for positives).
approach: Alternatively convert to string length for non-negatives.

python.code:
def count_digits(n: int) -> int:
    n = abs(n)
    if n == 0: return 1
    c = 0
    while n:
        c += 1
        n //= 10
    return c
